scripts.test:worker: mkdir -p worker/.test-build && ./worker/node_modules/.bin/esbuild worker/tests/connectors.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=worker/.test-build/connectors.test.mjs && node --test worker/.test-build/connectors.test.mjs; code=$?; rm -rf worker/.test-build; exit $code
scripts.setup: npm install && cd worker && npm install && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply solent-db --local
scripts.start: npm run build && cd worker && npx wrangler dev --port 3000
